contextUsed.text:
=== GLOBAL STANDARDS (L1) ===
test: true

=== PROJECT CONTEXT (L3) ===
name: rorca
type: web-app
stack:
  - React 18
  - TypeScript
  - Vite
  - Tailwind CSS
  - Express.js
  - SQLite (better-sqlite3)
  - xterm.js
  - react-router-dom
  - framer-motion
  - recharts
  - mermaid
  - monaco-editor
purpose: |
  Rorca is an AI spec orchestration platform for autonomous software development.
  It generates structured specs from plain-English briefs, manages approval workflows,
  and executes user stories via Claude CLI, OpenCode, or Codex with real-time monitoring.
key_modules:
  - "src/panels/ — React UI panels (Specs, Runs, Analytics, Direction, Settings)"
  - "src/components/ — Shared UI components (Sidebar, Shell, RunTerminal, CommandPalette)"
  - "backend/src/routes/ — Express API endpoints (32 route files)"
  - "backend/src/lib/execution-engine.ts — Ralph Loop subprocess orchestration"
  - "backend/src/lib/direction-stack.ts — 5-layer context synthesis"
  - "backend/src/lib/llm-client.ts — LLM provider abstraction"
  - "backend/src/lib/context-router.ts — Dynamic context payload compiler"
  - "backend/src/lib/sse-hub.ts — Centralized pub/sub for WAL events"
  - "backend/src/db/ — SQLite migrations and schema bootstrap"
  - "backend/src/mcp/server.ts — MCP stdio server (5 tools)"
  - "forge/specs/ — Spec JSON files (pending/, approved/)"
constraints:
  - "SQLite is synchronous (better-sqlite3) — no async DB calls"
  - "Backend has no hot-reload — restart required after changes"
  - "Spec id is filename slug, specName is human-readable title"
  - "All spec paths: forge/specs/approved/<slug>.json or forge/specs/pending/<slug>.json"
  - "WAL events table uses 'ts' column, NOT 'created_at'"
  - "Auth middleware is intentionally bypassed globally (local single-user tool)"
deployment_target: "Self-hosted (npm install + npm run dev) or Docker Compose"
integrations:
  - GitHub (OAuth, webhooks, PR creation)
  - Linear (issue sync)
  - Vercel (deploy triggers)
  - Slack (notifications)

=== SPEC BRIEF (L4) ===
Create a test that will an e2e audit of the UX architecture to ensure everything flows smoothly
